title: Chat

id.description: The unique identifier for the chat

name.description: The name of the chat (for group chats)

type.description: The type of chat (direct message or group chat)

participantIds.description: Array of eNames of the users participating in the chat. Entity references are eNames: an @-prefixed W3ID such as @48468c9a-dc1b-5663-92fb-5e46e3d2a7f0. eNames are used rather than User profile MetaEnvelope ids because they are stable, self-describing, and resolvable without a profile envelope, which a newly provisioned eVault may not have yet.

lastMessageId.description: ID of the most recent message in the chat

updatedAt.description: When the chat was last updated

admins.description: Array of eNames of the chat's administrators.

ename.description: The chat's own eName, when the chat is backed by a group eVault.

adminIds.description: Array of eNames of the chat or group's administrators. Alias of `admins` used by some platforms.

memberIds.description: Array of eNames of the group's members. Members, admins and the owner are all participants.

signatureIds.description: Ids of charter signature records. A record reference, not an entity reference.

originalMatchParticipants.description: Participants of the match this group originated from.

avatarUrl.description: Group avatar. A w3ds://file URI at rest.

bannerUrl.description: Group banner. A w3ds://file URI at rest.

eName.description: Deprecated casing of `ename`, still emitted by cerberus.

description: Chat and Group share this schema. Entity references — participantIds, admins/adminIds, memberIds and owner — are eNames: @-prefixed W3IDs such as @48468c9a-dc1b-5663-92fb-5e46e3d2a7f0. They are not User profile MetaEnvelope ids, which are unresolvable on their own and do not exist for an eVault with no profile envelope yet. Consumers skip references they cannot resolve rather than dropping the room.
